fusions.name: Tear-Out Barb
fusions.desc: Looses a barbed arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Snagline
fusions.desc: Fires a barbed arrow on a line that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Cast
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Barb Retrieval
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 3 seconds.
